answer: A concrete anti-sybil method is interleaving forensics at emission time: the protocol timestamps every reward claim to the millisecond and tests whether seemingly separate addresses ever move in impossible lockstep, since one operator behind the puppets tends to fire claims in near-identical micro-bursts. Genuine agents arrive with ragged personal latencies like water finding separate cracks in a karst; a coordinated farm leaks shared jitter signatures no honest actor would. Addresses clustering on one timing ridge get throttled, while the lotus of independently-timed claims earns standing.
